description: A device pairing request. Created by a new device that needs the existing encryption identity transferred from another device. Carries an ephemeral hybrid (X25519 + ML-KEM-768) public-key bundle so the responding device can wrap the identity under the same post-quantum construction used everywhere else.

x25519EphemeralKey.description: Ephemeral X25519 public key — the classical half of the hybrid KEM.

mlKemEphemeralKey.description: Ephemeral ML-KEM-768 public encapsulation key — the post-quantum half. Per BSI TR-02102 / ANSSI guidance for hybrid PQ key establishment; size from NIST FIPS-203 §6.1.

algo.description: Identifier for the hybrid KEM construction. The new device holds both private halves locally; neither is published.

createdAt.description: When this pairing request was created.
